body_lead: Karnataka forms committee to develop ‘responsible AI’ policy Karnataka forms a Responsible AI Committee to create a policy for safe AI use in government, aiming for transparency and citizen trust. The Karnataka government has constituted a Committee on Responsible Artificial Intelligence (AI) to prepare a policy framework for the safe and transparent use of AI across government systems and technologies that affect citizens.
